6.description: [Serpentshrine Cavern] [Hydross the Unstable] Pending Restarts - Reduced the damage of Mark of Hydross and Mark of Corruption by ~40%.
[Serpentshrine Cavern] The following changes are made in reaction to the recent resistance changes.
[Mythic+] Pending Restarts - Creature Affix - Necrotic - Necrosis now has a 2 seconds internal cooldown per caster.

[Mythic+] Pending Restarts - Creature Affix - Necrotic - Clarification regarding blocked attacks. Necrosis will apply on partially blocked attacks, Necrosis will not apply on fully blocked attacks. Necrosis previously applying to fully blocked attacks was caused in conjunction with absorb effects.
[Mythic+] Pending Restarts - Creature Affix - Necrotic - Corrected an issue where Necrotic was always applied if the creatures attack was absorbed or partially absorbed.

[Mythic+] Pending Restarts - Creature Affix - Necrotic - Necrotic now requires the casting creature to inflict damage with its attack in order to apply Necrosis. This will prevent unavoidable status effects such as Sunder Armor to apply stacks.
[Mythic+] Pending Restarts - Reduced the health scaling per Mythic Level for all creatures by 2%. Creatures will now reach the health value of previous Mythic 10 at Mythic 13.

Mythic Bonus Caches are now rewarded from 40% and 60% completion from 50% and 75%. Meeting these timers grants you an extra Mythic Cache!

6.description: [Dire Maul - West] Removed three trash creatures right on top of Tsu'zee. Tsu'zee can now be pulled without additional trash.
[Scholomance] Corrected an issue where creatures inside Scholomance dealt much more damage then intended.
[Darkmaster Gandling] Darkmaster Gandling will now summon a class of Risen Students at 50% remaining health.
[Darkmaster Gandling] Risen Guardians have been replaced with Risen Students.
[Instructor Malicia] Instructor Malicia no longer casts healing abilities.
[Raz Frostwhisper] Increased the damage of Shatter against targets affected by Deep Freeze by 100%.
[Raz Frostwhisper] Chill Nova no longer deals damage.

[Marduk Blackpool and Vectus]  Marduck Blackpool and Vectus are now considered a single boss encounter. Reduced health of both bosses by 50%. In order to successful complete the encounter, player need to kill both bosses in a single attempt. Failing the encounter will cause both bosses to respawn.

[Kirtonos the Herald] Kirtonos the Herald no longer changes form based on a timer, he changes form based on health percentage, switching from his undead form into his gargoyle form at 50% health remaining.
[Kirtonos the Herald] Kirtonos the Herald no longer knocks targets back.
[Scholomance] Greatly improved the logic of caster creatures throughout the dungeon.
[Scholomance] Reduced the amount of CC abilities available to creatures throughout the dungeon.
[Scholomance] All creatures inside Scholomance now use improved versions of their old abilities and partially new abilities.
[Scholomance] Scholomance has been reworked.
[Mythic+] Reduced the damage increase per Mythic level by 3%. Creatures reach the equivalent to previous Mythic 10 at Mythic 16.

[Mythic+] With Mythic level 14, Champions are introduced. Champions are creatures with their own evolving Champion affix, unlocking additional effects on higher Mythic levels. Starting with level 14, Champions are now an additional objective to complete a Mythic Dungeon.
[Mythic+] Mythic 11 to 20 is now available.

[Alar][Ascended Raids] Introducing a system that is live on Area-52, whenever the next raid tier comes out, the previous raid tier no longer requires an attunement quest to be completed.

For example: Once Onyxia is out, this means Molten Core no longer requires attunement. Once Blackwing Lair is released Onyxia no longer requires an attunement to enter. 

This change only affects Ascended Raids as they are the raids that require attunement.
